name: Shikima Nene
source:
Discipline Committee Member in Dilemma
She should have been the one enforcing the rules, yet her "antenna" for this kind of thing is peculiarly sensitive.
The moment she detects a breach of discipline, she materializes out of thin air and immediately gets lost in a self-indulgent rampage.
Shuichi, however, proves to be a formidable challenge; her plans constantly backfire, leaving her in a perpetual state of frustration.
